request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
## Residence permit expiry

Your residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) expires **Mon 30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

## What to do before then

- **Attend the Ausländerbehörde appointment** on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp] to apply for the extension. Bring your passport, enrolment certificate, proof of financing, health insurance proof, a biometric photo, and your rental contract/landlord confirmation.
- **Pay the €100 fee** [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m] on site, by girocard only (no cash).
- **File the extension application before the permit expires** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. If you do, your stay is treated as continuing until the office decides (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG) — ask for a *Fiktionsbescheinigung* as proof. If you don't apply in time, your lawful residence status ends when the permit expires.
- **Check your passport's validity**: a residence permit usually can't run longer than your passport, and yours is flagged for renewal too, due Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse] — worth confirming it will stay valid long enough. This date needs checking, so please verify it against your passport.
- **If you can't make the appointment**, cancel it at least three business days beforehand [item:itm_5frk207bsfq1] so the slot can be reassigned.

You can add these dates to your calendar or draft any needed reply from within Ordnung.
